title: High Protein Cocoa Puffs
subtitle: with chocolate & oats (Air Fryer)
preparation: In a mixing bowl, combine oat flour, cocoa powder, protein powder, brown sugar, baking soda, and instant coffee powder. Whisk thoroughly.
Gradually add milk (5 to 6 tbsp), stirring until a soft, pliable chocolate dough forms.
Pinch small pieces of dough and roll them into miniature balls (puffs) with your palms.
Arrange puffs in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry at 170°C for 21 minutes until crispy and crunchy. Let cool, serve with fresh milk or yogurt!
content:
Oat flour: 45–50 g
Cocoa powder: 20–25 g
Protein powder: 35–40 g
Brown sugar: 20–25 g (2 tbsp)
Baking soda: 5 g (1 tsp)
Instant coffee powder: 2–4 g (1 to 2 tsp)
Milk: 75–90 g (5 to 6 tbsp; add gradually)

170 degree 21mint

title: Vanilla Egg Sponge Cake
subtitle: Air Fryer & Stovepot Method
preparation: Whisk eggs, sugar, oil/butter & vanilla until light and frothy. Sift in flour, salt, milk & Eno (½ tsp replaces baking powder); fold gently into a smooth batter.
Air Fryer: Preheat at 160°C (3–5 min). Bake at 150°C–160°C for 20–25 min (up to 30–35 min depending on model).
Stove Method: Preheat heavy pot on low 10 min. Place batter inside, seal tight with lid so no steam escapes. Bake on lowest flame 35–45 min (keep lid closed first 30 min).
Toothpick Test: Check cake quickly at 20–25 min. Clean toothpick = done (remove immediately)! Wet batter = add 2–3 min. Check fast so air fryer retains heat.
Pro-Tip: If top browns too fast before center sets, tent a small sheet of foil over cake to protect top while center finishes baking.
content:
All-purpose flour: 60g – 65g
Sugar: 50g
Neutral oil: 40g (or butter 40g)
Eggs: 100g (2 eggs, whisked)
Eno (unflavored): 2g (1/2 tsp)
Salt: 1g
Vanilla extract: 3g – 5g
Milk: 10ml

• Air Fryer: Preheat 160°C (3–5 min). Bake 150°C–160°C for 20–25 min (up to 35 min).
• Stove: Preheat pot on low 10 min. Seal tight; bake on lowest flame 35–45 min.
• Toothpick test at 20–25 min. Check quickly to keep heat! Tent foil if top browns early.
